report.summary: Implemented write_csv() and write_parquet() in src/demo_app/export/. CSV round-trips the sample forecast. Parquet writer currently drops the UTC offset; fixing by casting to timestamp[us, tz=UTC] before writing. Re-running tests.

decisions.q: Should pyarrow be a required dependency or an optional extra?
decisions.explain: Parquet export needs pyarrow (~40 MB). The project currently has no pyarrow dependency. Making it optional keeps installs small; CSV export works either way. Suggested: optional extra.

options.label: Optional extra [parquet]
